items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: Wild Bill and Sir Charles came by my house one Sunday afternoon and played all night, all day rather.

ctx.x: Oh sure it is. Sure it is, yes. Actually I'm five years older than Sir Charles, but they both were beginners at that time. And
